FROSTSWORN_RELIC_WINTER_CROWN.title: Core of Deep Winter
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_WINTER_CROWN.descriptio:
At the start of each combat, apply 5 [gold]Frost[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Each turn, apply 2 [gold]Frost[/gold] to ALL enemies.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_WINTER_CROWN.flavor: A relic left behind by winter.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_SNOW_BOOKMARK.title: Snowflake Bookmark
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_SNOW_BOOKMARK.descripti: At the end of your turn, gain 1 [gold]Ice Armor[/gold] for each card in [gold]Cold Storage[/gold].
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_SNOW_BOOKMARK.flavor: A relic left behind by winter.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_POLAR_GLOBE.title: Polar Orrery
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_POLAR_GLOBE.description: Every time you put 3 cards into [gold]Cold Storage[/gold], you may choose up to 1 card to [gold]Thaw[/gold].
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_POLAR_GLOBE.flavor: A relic left behind by winter.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_WINTER_BOTTLE.title: Bottle of Lingering Winter
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_WINTER_BOTTLE.descripti: Before your first draw each combat, choose 1 card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to put into [gold]Cold Storage[/gold].
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_WINTER_BOTTLE.flavor: A relic left behind by winter.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_ICE_KEY.title: Ice Key
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_ICE_KEY.description: The first time you [gold]Freeze[/gold] an enemy each turn, deal 12 damage to that enemy.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_ICE_KEY.flavor: A relic left behind by winter.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_FROZEN_SOIL.title: Frozen Soil
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_FROZEN_SOIL.description: After [gold]Ice Armor[/gold] melts for the first time each combat, gain 7 [gold]Ice Armor[/gold].
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_FROZEN_SOIL.flavor: A relic left behind by winter.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_SNOW_PRIMER.title: The Super-Easy Beginner's Guide to Snow Magic!
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_SNOW_PRIMER.description: Double the first [gold]Snowfall[/gold] you gain each turn.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_SNOW_PRIMER.flavor: A relic left behind by winter.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_FROST_DIPLOMA.title: Advanced Cryomancer's Certificate
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_FROST_DIPLOMA.descripti: Whenever you deal damage to an enemy, apply 1 [gold]Frost[/gold] to it.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_FROST_DIPLOMA.flavor: A relic left behind by winter.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_WINTER_CORE.title: Winterbound Core
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_WINTER_CORE.description: At the start of each combat, apply 3 [gold]Frost[/gold] to ALL enemies.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_WINTER_CORE.flavor: It holds a city's last remaining warmth.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_BLOODLESS_CORD.title: Bloodless Cord
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_BLOODLESS_CORD.descript:
Whenever you climb a floor, heal 1 HP.
Disables Blood Vial.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_BLOODLESS_CORD.flavor: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_DROWNED_FLOAT.title: Drowner's Float
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_DROWNED_FLOAT.descripti:
Once per combat, reduce the first enemy Attack that would cause you to lose HP by 15.
Disables Anchor.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_DROWNED_FLOAT.flavor: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_RUMINATION_SAC.title: Ruminating Sac
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_RUMINATION_SAC.descript:
After your first shuffle each combat, draw 3 cards.
Disables Bag of Preparation.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_RUMINATION_SAC.flavor: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MIRROR_PARASITE.title: Mirror-Shell Parasite
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MIRROR_PARASITE.descrip:
The first time each turn an enemy Attack uses your [gold]Block[/gold], deal damage to the attacker equal to the [gold]Block[/gold] used, up to 11.
Disables Bronze Scales.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MIRROR_PARASITE.flavor: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MEMORY_SLOUGH.title: Memory Slough
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MEMORY_SLOUGH.descripti:
The first time you lose HP each combat, look at the top 3 cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Put 1 into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the rest.
Disables Centennial Puzzle.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MEMORY_SLOUGH.flavor: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_LIGHT_MOTH_COCOON.title: Light-Eater Cocoon
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_LIGHT_MOTH_COCOON.descr:
At the start of each combat, choose a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs 2 less and gains [gold]Exhaust[/gold] this turn.
Disables Lantern.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_LIGHT_MOTH_COCOON.flavo: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_CURLED_POLYP.title: Curled Polyp
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_CURLED_POLYP.descriptio:
At the end of the enemy turn, heal 4 HP. After you lose HP to an enemy, this relic is disabled for the rest of combat.
Disables Orichalcum.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_CURLED_POLYP.flavor: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_TRIOCULAR_WAX.title: Three-Eyed Wax Growth
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_TRIOCULAR_WAX.descripti:
At the start of your 2nd turn, 3 random cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] cost 1 less this turn.
Disables Candelabra.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_TRIOCULAR_WAX.flavor: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_FACEBORROW_MEMBRANE.des:
At the start of each combat, gain 3 [gold]Strength[/gold] and 3 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Lose 1 of each bonus at the end of each of your turns.
Disables Sparkling Rouge.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_FACEBORROW_MEMBRANE.fla: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MERISTEM_TEETH.title: Budding Incisors
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MERISTEM_TEETH.descript:
At the start of each combat, choose 2 cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to [gold]Upgrade[/gold] for this combat. Put 1 of them into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
Disables Stone Cracker.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MERISTEM_TEETH.flavor: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_HANGING_STAR_SAC.title: Inverted Star Sac
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_HANGING_STAR_SAC.descri:
At the start of your 4th turn, all cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] cost 0 this turn.
Disables Chandelier.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_HANGING_STAR_SAC.flavor: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MARROW_TOUCH.title: Marrow-Tethered Touch
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MARROW_TOUCH.descriptio:
At the end of combat, if you have at least 50% of your Max HP, gain 5 Max HP.
Disables Meat on the Bone.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MARROW_TOUCH.flavor: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MOLDY_COOKIE.title: Moldy Cookie
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MOLDY_COOKIE.descriptio:
Every 2nd combat, all card rewards from that combat are [gold]Upgraded[/gold].
Disables Lasting Candy.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_MOLDY_COOKIE.flavor: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_GYMNOSPERM_PENDANT.desc:
Whenever you use a Potion, gain 2 [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Lose 1 of this bonus at the end of each of your turns.
Disables Reptile Trinket.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_GYMNOSPERM_PENDANT.flav: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_OVERDRIVE_GEARBOX.title: Overdrive Gearbox
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_OVERDRIVE_GEARBOX.descr:
Every 7 cards you play, gain Vigor equal to twice your current turn number, up to 20.
Disables Tuning Fork.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_OVERDRIVE_GEARBOX.flavo: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_LIGHTHOUSE_JELLY.title: Lighthouse Jellyfish
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_LIGHTHOUSE_JELLY.descri:
When you would die, if you have more than 10 Max HP, heal 15% of your Max HP, gain 16 [gold]Block[/gold], and lose 11 Max HP.
Disables Lizard Tail.
FROSTSWORN_RELIC_LIGHTHOUSE_JELLY.flavor: Something familiar lives inside. Something else looks back.
